title: Naccam
text: 4. Evam eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye naccagīta-vādita-visūkadassanā paṭiviratā || atha kho ete va bahutarā sattā ye nacca-gīta-vādita-visūkadassanā appaṭiviratā [page 471] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 471 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || || Taṃ kissa hetu || la || ||
